description: This PHP class file defines a User class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. The class manages user session attributes, flash messages, and authentication status, serving as a core component for user-related functionality in the HRM system.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user within the OrangeHRM authentication system, managing user session attributes, authentication status, roles, and flash messages.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the User class.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the session object from the service container.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a session attribute exists.

methods.name: addFlash
methods.description: Adds a flash message of a specific type.

methods.name: getFlash
methods.description: Retrieves flash messages of a specific type.

methods.name: hasFlash
methods.description: Checks if flash messages of a specific type exist.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: getUserLastModified
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the last user modification.

methods.name: setUserLastModified
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last user modification.

methods.name: getHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Checks if user has admin access.

methods.name: setHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Sets the user's admin access status.
